ABOUT
-----
FEN is a Vietnamese freelance web designer and developer who handles every stage of
web production independently: from initial concept and wireframing through visual design
in Figma, to front-end development and deployment on Vercel/Netlify.

This end-to-end approach means clients work with one person throughout the project —
with a single consistent creative vision from start to finish. No agency handoffs,
no outsourcing, no communication overhead.

Design philosophy: premium visual quality, strong typographic hierarchy, intentional
negative space, subtle motion, and fast-loading pages that respect the user's attention.

Specializes in dark luxury interfaces, editorial design systems, and GSAP-powered
motion experiences.

SERVICES
--------
1. Web Design (UI/UX, visual design, editorial layout systems, Figma)
2. Front-End Development (React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS)
3. Creative Direction (art direction, brand visual strategy, photography direction)
4. Motion & Interaction Design (GSAP 3, ScrollTrigger, micro-animations)
5. Landing Page Design & Development (conversion-optimized, fast-loading)
6. Portfolio Website Design (creative professionals, studios, photographers)
7. E-commerce Website Design (product showcases, checkout flows, brand stores)
8. Healthcare Website Design (clinics, dental, spa, wellness centers)
9. Education Platform Design (LMS, course websites, language schools)
10. Corporate & Business Website Design (B2B, SaaS, corporate identity)

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
---------------------------
Q: What services does FEN offer?
A: FEN offers web design, UI/UX design, front-end development with React and TypeScript,
   creative direction, GSAP motion design, landing page design, e-commerce website design,
   and corporate/healthcare/education website design.

Q: Where is FEN based and does FEN work internationally?
A: FEN is based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (GMT+7) and works with clients worldwide
   on a fully remote basis. Fluent in Vietnamese and English.

Q: How many projects has FEN completed?
A: 32 website projects from 2022 to 2026, across creative studios, healthcare, beauty,
   fashion, real estate, education, and corporate sectors.

Q: How can I hire FEN for a project?
A: Contact FEN via the form at https://white-web-design.vercel.app/#contact or
   directly at hello@fen.studio. FEN typically responds within 24-48 hours.

Q: What is FEN's design specialty?
A: Dark luxury interfaces, editorial design systems, GSAP-powered motion experiences,
   and premium portfolio/brand websites. FEN is particularly known for sophisticated
   dark UI, strong typographic hierarchy, and intentional use of negative space.

Q: What technologies does FEN use?
A: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP animations, Figma for design.
   Deployed on Vercel with performance-optimized builds.
